guesses.reason: Short dense brown-gray coat with classic mackerel tabby striping, an 'M' marking on the forehead, and an average, slender young build point to a typical random-bred tabby.
The rounded face, sturdy cheeks, and well-defined dark tabby stripes resemble American Shorthair features, though the coat is browner and less silver.
The large, tall, wide-set ears and warm ticked tones on the face hint faintly at Abyssinian influence.

breed.appearance: A young, slender brown mackerel tabby with a ticked tan-and-gray coat striped with narrow black bands along the sides and legs, a bold dark 'M' on the forehead, and dark lines running back from the outer corners of the eyes. She has very large, upright, pointed ears with pale pink insides, round yellow-green eyes, a rosy-brown nose outlined in dark, and a creamy white muzzle, chin, and throat with long white whiskers. She wears a thin pink collar and sits in a compact loaf position.
breed.fun_fact: Brown tabbies like Paulina all wear a signature 'M' on their foreheads, a built-in badge of tabby charm!
